description: The pie chart represents the error rate for different slots in the Continual DST task, comparing the performance of LLaMA-7B and T5 small models. The chart is divided into 14 slices, each representing a different slot with its corresponding error rate. The largest slice, representing the 'date' slot, has an error rate of 19.30%, followed by the 'from' slot at 17.00%. The 'genre' slot has an error rate of 13.50%, and the 'to' slot is at 14.50%. The 'name' slot has a slightly higher error rate of 5.20%. The 'size' and 'time' slots have error rates of 4.20% and 4.10%, respectively. The 'intent' and 'location' slots are both at 3.80%, while the 'destination' slot is at 3.00%. The 'city' and 'class' slots have error rates of 2.60% and 2.40%, respectively. The 'range' and 'beds' slots are at 2.20% and 1.30%, and the 'type' slot has the lowest error rate at 2.00%. The 'passengers' slot has the smallest slice with an error rate of 1.10%. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The slices are ordered by size, starting with the largest error rate and ending with the smallest.
